weather.protocolHeavyText: Saturated soil conditions accelerate nitrogen leaching. Postpone any planned top-dressing of urea fertilizer until topsoil drains completely.
weather.defenseHeatText: High thermal stress increases evapotranspiration rates. Apply a light straw or dry leaf mulch around crop bases to preserve deep root moisture.
weather.fungalText: High relative humidity combined with warm air creates an infection window for leaf spot and blight. Ensure field boundaries are weeded to maintain air flow.
weather.optimalText: Current atmospheric temperature and moisture levels are ideal for standard field maintenance, foliar nutrient spraying, and routine weeding operations.
